_comment: Redacted real bank SMS used to check the V1.3.0 seed templates (BankSmsTemplateSeedTest).
Source: leadsgen-tech/salli, Apache-2.0, samples/redacted/*.txt and parser fixtures. Names, phone numbers and
references are already replaced by the source ([NAME], [PHONE], [REF]).
Account numbers and transaction/reference numbers are further replaced here with synthetic digits of the same length.
One marketing message in mustNotMatch was written for this test, and is labelled so.
These are third-party samples: evidence status COMMUNITY_SOURCE_NEEDS_VALIDATION, not MoneyReserve-sourced.
expected.maskedTail null means the device must send no tail. txnDate is omitted where the SMS has no date
(the template falls back to the SMS received date).
